reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 12.1.1 sets a definite Term ending at expiry of the last Royalty Term or lapse of the License Option Period, with no evergreen/auto-renewal mechanic, non-renewal notice window, or renewal price-uplift language.

Absence of auto-renewal means any extension requires a mutual written amendment, which matches the playbook's preferred position ('renewal only by mutual written agreement'), so no redline or counterparty comment is expected — and none was proposed (redline is byte-identical to the original).
The failed deterministic check ('non-renewal notice window ≤ 60 days: number not found') is expected here, since there is no notice window to measure; it does not indicate a defect in the finding.
Rationale correctly notes that Section 12.1.2 converts our licence to a fully-paid, royalty-free, irrevocable grant on expiry — a term favourable to our side, properly not flagged.
